# Pixcellor™

> Pixcellor is a UK digital agency that builds bespoke, fast-loading websites and full-stack web apps for businesses, delivered as monthly retainers from £89/month with lifetime guarantee, SEO/AEO, unlimited edits and a 2-week MVP sprint option.

Pixcellor offers three retainer packages: Growth (£89/mo, website + unlimited edits, CRM, AI bots and hosting for small businesses), Scale (£479/mo, everything in Growth plus unlimited seats, priority 24/7 support, custom AI agents and monthly strategy calls), and Enterprise (£2,469/mo, fractional CTO & CMO with a dedicated dev/ops squad and weekly MVP sprints). Services include web design, web development, app development, full-stack development, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), Web3, blockchain and AI integration.
